what: Collapse Duplicate Key Groups in Tibbles with Safe Concatenation
title: Collapse Duplicate Key Groups in Tibbles with Safe Concatenation
text: TableCleaneR provides small, focused helpers collapse duplicate rows defined key columns tibbles/data frames, way safe downstream analysis: Key combinations made unique collapsing rows sharing keys. Selected columns can concatenated preserve information (e.g. sources, comments). divergent non-key fields replaced typed NA avoid silently mixing inconsistent values. Companion functions help audit groups require concatenation subset collapsed outputs accordingly.

title: Collapse Duplicate Key Groups in Tibbles with Safe Concatenation
text: (Alternatively)

title: Collapse Duplicate Key Groups in Tibbles with Safe Concatenation
text: TableCleaneR currently exposes four functions: collapse_by_keys(): collapse duplicates one row per key group; concatenate .concat columns needed; replace divergent columns NA. collapse_candidates(): return original input rows belonging groups concatenation needed .concat. collapse_concat_only(): return collapsed output restricted groups concatenation actually occurred. collapse_no_concat(): return collapsed output restricted groups concatenation needed .concat.

title: Collapse Duplicate Key Groups in Tibbles with Safe Concatenation
code: library(TableCleaneR) library(dplyr) #>  #> Attachement du package : 'dplyr' #> Les objets suivants sont masqués depuis 'package:stats': #>  #>     filter, lag #> Les objets suivants sont masqués depuis 'package:base': #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union library(tibble)  df <- tibble(   exam.num_collec = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2),   mat.matrice = c("SER", "SER", "SER", "PLAS", "PLAS"),   spe.denomination = c(     "E. coli",     "E. coli",     "E. coli",     "S. aureus",     "S. aureus"   ),   result = c("POS", "NEG", "POS", "NEG", "NEG"), # divergent (non-concat) for key=1   value = c(10, 10, 12, 5, 5), # divergent (non-concat) for key=1   commentaire = c("first", NA, "repeat", "ok", "ok"), # concat target   source_info = c("labA", "labA", "labB", "labC", NA), # concat target   flag = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE) # constant within groups )  df #> # A tibble: 5 × 8 #>   exam.num_collec mat.matrice spe.denomination result value commentaire #>             <dbl> <chr>       <chr>            <chr>  <dbl> <chr>       #> 1               1 SER         E. coli          POS       10 first       #> 2               1 SER         E. coli          NEG       10 <NA>        #> 3               1 SER         E. coli          POS       12 repeat      #> 4               2 PLAS        S. aureus        NEG        5 ok          #> 5               2 PLAS        S. aureus        NEG        5 ok          #> # ℹ 2 more variables: source_info <chr>, flag <lgl>

title: Collapse Duplicate Key Groups in Tibbles with Safe Concatenation
text: Expected behaviour (key group (1, "SER", "E. coli")): commentaire becomes "first | repeat" (distinct non-NA values concatenated), source_info becomes "labA | labB", result value become NA (divergent selected concatenation), flag stays TRUE (constant within group).
code: collapsed <- df %>%   collapse_by_keys(     exam.num_collec,     mat.matrice,     spe.denomination,     .concat = c(commentaire, source_info),     sep = " | ",     na_rm = TRUE,     warn = TRUE   ) #> Warning: Divergent columns replaced by NA: result, value  collapsed #> # A tibble: 2 × 8 #>   exam.num_collec mat.matrice spe.denomination result value commentaire    #>             <dbl> <chr>       <chr>            <chr>  <dbl> <chr>          #> 1               1 SER         E. coli          <NA>      NA first | repeat #> 2               2 PLAS        S. aureus        NEG        5 ok             #> # ℹ 2 more variables: source_info <chr>, flag <lgl>

what: Collapse duplicate key groups, concatenating selected columns and replacing other divergences with NA — collapse_by_keys
title: Collapse duplicate key groups, concatenating selected columns and replacing other divergences with NA — collapse_by_keys
text: collapse_by_keys() enforces uniqueness key combinations collapsing (merging) rows share keys (provided ...). output contains exactly one row per unique key combination. non-key column within key group: column single distinct value within group (optionally ignoring NA according na_rm), value kept. column multiple distinct values: column selected .concat, distinct values concatenated single character string using sep (optional NA removal). Otherwise, column set NA collapsed row (typed NA via vctrs::vec_cast()). warn = TRUE, function emits warning listing non-key columns (excluding .concat) divergent least one group therefore replaced NA (affected groups).

title: Collapse duplicate key groups, concatenating selected columns and replacing other divergences with NA — collapse_by_keys
text: .data data frame tibble. ... Key columns defining groups must unique output. Uses tidyeval. .concat Optional tidyselect specification non-key columns whose divergent values concatenated. NULL (default), columns concatenated. sep String used separate concatenated values. na_rm Logical. TRUE, ignore NA values assessing distinctness within group concatenating. FALSE, NA participates distinctness (.e., c("", NA) divergent). warn Logical. TRUE, emit warning listing columns (excluding keys .concat) divergent least one group replaced NA.

title: Collapse duplicate key groups, concatenating selected columns and replacing other divergences with NA — collapse_by_keys
text: Type behavior Columns selected .concat return character result concatenation needed. may change type columns output. non-.concat columns, divergent groups replaced typed NA using vctrs::vec_cast(NA, x) preserve column's type whenever possible. output ungrouped tibble (.groups = "drop").

title: Collapse duplicate key groups, concatenating selected columns and replacing other divergences with NA — collapse_by_keys
code: library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: ‘dplyr’ #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’: #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’: #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union library(tibble)  df <- tibble(   exam.num_collec  = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2),   mat.matrice      = c("SER", "SER", "SER", "PLAS", "PLAS"),   spe.denomination = c("E. coli", "E. coli", "E. coli", "S. aureus", "S. aureus"),   result           = c("POS", "NEG", "POS", "NEG", "NEG"),   value            = c(10, 10, 12, 5, 5),   commentaire      = c("first", NA, "repeat", "ok", "ok"),   source_info      = c("labA", "labA", "labB", "labC", NA),   flag             = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE) )  # Collapse by keys: # - concatenate selected text columns if needed # - replace other divergent columns by NA out <- df %>%   collapse_by_keys(     exam.num_collec, mat.matrice, spe.denomination,     .concat = c(commentaire, source_info),     sep = " | ",     na_rm = TRUE,     warn = TRUE   ) #> Warning: Divergent columns replaced by NA: result, value  out #> # A tibble: 2 × 8 #>   exam.num_collec mat.matrice spe.denomination result value commentaire    #>             <dbl> <chr>       <chr>            <chr>  <dbl> <chr>          #> 1               1 SER         E. coli          NA        NA first | repeat #> 2               2 PLAS        S. aureus        NEG        5 ok             #> # ℹ 2 more variables: source_info <chr>, flag <lgl>
